Attached: 1 image

I wanted to see if I could build something “real” with Mew, my hobby programming language that compiles to .NET, so I wrote a snake game with Sokol (by @floooh@mastodon.gamedev.place) and SDL 3.

I think it just graduated from “completely useless” to “fun toy language”... I’m especially happy with the build system, which is written in Mew too.

https://github.com/patriksvensson/mew-snake

#gamedev #programming #dotnet
